headline: St. Mary's beat Oklahoma Christian, face unbeaten Midwestern State next
dek: Oklahoma Christian had not lost since conference play opened until St. Mary's won at their ground on Wednesday. Midwestern State, who host St. Mary's on Saturday, drew with UT Dallas the same night and have now won fourteen and drawn five this season without a loss.
displaced_by: The standing dek no longer held: Midwestern State's draw with UT Dallas makes five draws and fourteen conceded, and St. Mary's beat Oklahoma Christian to set up a meeting with Midwestern State.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fourteen different players have scored Midwestern State's 50 goals, and Parker Plaxco has fifteen of them.

wire.line: Every side but Midwestern State has now lost at least once.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian have lost four times, and St. Mary's are the only conference side to have beaten them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have lost twice, against eleven wins and seven draws, and conceded sixteen goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all sixteen of their matches and scored twice.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made 78 saves for Sul Ross State.

last_match.line: Oklahoma Christian had beaten St. Mary's in conference play; St. Mary's took the second meeting, and go to Midwestern State next.

next_match.line: St. Mary's lost on their last visit to Midwestern State, in conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
